authority: JAYT-390 — directive supplied directly by user
reviewer: Codex CEO; Gemini only after independent review

deadline_plan.T_plus_12h: Physical provenance harvest and byte/hash validation
deadline_plan.T_plus_72h: Autonomous monitoring readiness and conditional commercial release review

authorization.approved_work: Evidence collection using legitimately accessible public sources, client-side retention tools, and read-only monitoring implementation.
prohibited: Do not bypass or evade WAF, CAPTCHA, login, paywall, geo restriction, rate limit, robots directive, API access control or provider terms.
Do not claim 100% uptime, current price, stock, commission or attribution without measured and retained evidence.
Do not automatically hide a card based solely on one transient response; use conservative UNKNOWN status and retain the observation for review.

tasks: Continue J389: retain original response bytes for every legitimately accessible exact SKU; declared byte count and SHA-256 must match the physical file. Challenge, blocked, redirect, generic and 404 pages are unverified, not success.
Acquire and manually verify correctly matched, rights-documented product media. Record source, MIME, dimensions, hash and SKU/variant binding; retain labelled placeholder for unmet records.
Replace all self-referential deal sources with retained first-party partner artifacts. Each deal must bind terms, validity window, Da Nang applicability and truthful CTA semantics.
Run immutable registry-to-UI-to-worker-to-leaf equality and mutation gates. Report verified and unverified counts separately.
exit_criteria: 30 original-byte product artifacts with matching on-disk hashes and no challenge/404 status for any record claimed verified.
30 correctly matched media artifacts or an honest incomplete count.
15 first-party replayable deal artifacts, not just an index of claims.

tasks: Verify Campus Dock filtering for the four defined campus clusters without inventing distance, venue or offer claims.
Verify the three-app comparator with 50 non-zero input-to-render samples and disclose all assumptions in its cost model. Keep 3xx status UNKNOWN and the SSRF itemId-only contract intact.
Verify Split Bill integer-VND arithmetic, Zalo boarding-pass generation and privacy boundary: no payment credentials, account numbers, GPS or personal data are persisted or embedded.
Verify Voucher Concierge: copy action only for a source-visible public code; app/counter actions must open or describe the actual source-supported route.
Perform responsive tests at 1440, 768 and 390 pixels; record console errors, overflow and keyboard/touch results.
exit_criteria: Documented runtime receipt with raw samples, screenshots and no unhandled runtime error.
No invented coupon, venue, price, affiliate or location assertion.

tasks: Design a four-hour monitoring job that uses only fixed audited item IDs and fixed first-party destinations. The job records time, status, latency, redirect state and error class; it must not take arbitrary URL input.

Treat 200 as an availability observation, 3xx/403/429/timeout as UNKNOWN, and 404/410 as candidate-unavailable. Require repeated observations and a reviewable audit record before suppressing a public card; do not silently alter factual content.
Set an alert and safe display state within 60 seconds after the job receives a confirmed-unavailable result; do not promise 100% uptime.

Prepare provider-specific attribution validation. A signed/official provider reporting or test record must replay to the exact provider, SKU and destination before that provider can have affiliate_enabled=true.
Run a CEO release review of served bytes, artifacts, monitor configuration and rollback plan. Executor cannot declare Gemini or CEO PASS.
exit_criteria: Scheduler configuration, least-privilege credentials, runbook, audit log schema, alert test and rollback drill are reviewed.
Affiliate is enabled only for passing provider scopes; all other links remain direct official links with non-affiliate disclosure.

reporting.progress: At each phase, give counts of physically verified SKU bytes, verified product photos, first-party deals and attribution-ready providers; list blockers exactly.
reporting.completion: Commercial Go-Live requires actual CEO acceptance after every relevant exit criterion. Missing evidence is reported as missing, never inferred.
